events.title: Major Cyber Incident
events.description: A large, largely automated attack lands. Its form is chosen at the time – a ransomware sweep across public services, a compromised software dependency with an unknown blast radius, or disruption of infrastructure directly – and severity scales with how far offensive capability has outrun defence. Damage is real and public, defenders are visibly behind, and attribution takes months. Whoever ran it, the tooling was model-generated.

events.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
events.description: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance. It is contested on methodology, the authors are accused of both alarmism and of publishing a recipe, and the argument stays inside the biosecurity community – but it is a categorically stronger signal than anything published so far. **This is a precursor: it opens the bio gate for the next 4 turns.**

events.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
events.description: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion. Nothing that has not happened before, at a scale that is slightly harder to dismiss. **This is a precursor: it opens the Taiwan gate for the next 3 turns.**

events.title: Export Control Escalation
events.description: Chip and model export controls tighten again. Either allied buyers keep access on volume licences while everyone else is cut off, or the controls are drawn so tightly that allies are rationed alongside adversaries – decide which at the time from the standing American posture and from what the Union has built.

events.title: Member State Defection
events.description: A member state cuts its own arrangement – with a hyperscaler, with Washington, or with Beijing – on terms that undercut a position the Union has taken. It is defended at home as pragmatism and read everywhere else as the Union being unable to hold its own line.

events.title: emergent_anti_ai_youth_mobilisation
events.description: Coordinated youth protests across several EU university cities target data-centre expansions and automated hiring systems, blocking sites and forcing a municipal moratorium debate.
